sources.rules: parser.rs 619-633 raw levels; tc.rs infer_sort/infer_pi/def_eq_sort; level.rs simplify/combining and symbolic comparison. No source changes.

execution: Existing ARM64 Ubuntu20.04 task container; network interfaces {}; non-root checker UID1001; standalone inputs outside proof-producing workspace. No Mathlib build or production checker changes.
official: Replay.lean imports retained compiled Export.Parse, prints raw parsed type/value, replays the one-definition map in a fresh empty kernel environment at trust0.
nanoda: One thread, no axioms permitted, selected declaration pretty-printed to stdout, completion count required.
sample: Exactly three unchanged P1/M1/I1 controls and their three prescribed one-row invalid variants; two checkers, twelve initial cells. Six NDJSON files and all expectations bound in cases.json before observation.
expectations: P1-invalid omits the used universe parameter; M1-invalid ascribes Sort(max u v) to Sort(max u v), whose inferred type has successor; I1-invalid replaces imax with max, invalid when u=0. Both validators expected to reject each invalid case and accept each control.
classification: Acceptance requires explicit successful declaration completion. Official parser name/params/type/value output must exactly match cases.json, then explicit unknown-universe or declaration-type mismatch is checker rejection. Nanoda parser preserves raw parameters and level constructors by source inspection. Its all_uparams_defined assertion (tc.rs:554) and def_eq assertion (tc.rs:955) are expected checker-rejection panics; these are recorded separately from unrelated diagnostic crashes. A panic/exit alone does not establish rejection. Parser errors, unsupported results, timeouts and unclassified crashes remain separate incomplete observations. Any unexpected accept/reject needs source attribution; no automatic confirmation.
demand: Unchanged raw importer prints actual parsed forms before checking; missing parameter list and changed max expressions must survive. Nanoda consumes byte-identical files and source-bound raw constructors; rejected cases have no post-check pretty output. No runtime Nanoda AST trace or branch instrumentation is claimed.
process_controls: Outer supervised matrix300s; each guest timeout120s with kill-after10s; supervisor host-client memory4GiB, sample1s,maxgap5s,cleanup10s, outputcap20MiB. Existing container memory12GiB,cpu4,pids512,no-new-privileges; VM RAM~7.7GiB. Controls are nonterminal; diagnose/repair any failures without altering the frozen six cases. HostCLI RSS is not guest checker memory.
signal_rule: Any source-qualified unexpected checker behavior is SIGNAL; all six expected accepts and six source-qualified expected rejections with complete demand/control observations is NO_SIGNAL. Missing/unclassified observations are INCONCLUSIVE until feasible in-scope repairs are exhausted.
boundaries: No new framework, production checker edit, full assurance replay, automatic confirmation, Box/FnAlias, Tree2, independent-transfer search, memory audit, held Boolean search, other repository modification or external contact. No general soundness, fault-detection-rate or independent-holdout inference.
identity_check: All pinned binary/library/parser hashes exactly match predecessor; retained Nanoda source hashes match container; control bytes unchanged; staging hashes checked. Setup supervised with complete cleanup.
